reporting.macro_f1: unweighted mean across represented groups within each stratum
reporting.weighted_f1: support-weighted mean across represented groups within each stratum

notes: All final sensitivity metrics are calculated post hoc on independent test predictions.
The complete sensitivity table retains all test records because the vegetation-height warning is itself a reported sensitivity contrast; group-performance and gate analyses exclude that warning.
The NAIP and CHM within-cell measures characterize neighborhood vegetation occupancy, not focal-crown coverage.
